row.notes: In Game_PitLane_ProjectBoxPose: mov r14d,edi (edi = box index, the pit lane record +0xe0) then mov r8,[rbx+r14*8+0x7f8], the cached spline handle of the box. Game_PitLane_GenerateSplines 0x1434ca550 zeroes 24 such slots (0x7f8..0x8b7); tuning handles follow from +0x8b8 and the per-car records start at mgr+0x938, and on a miss 0x1434c36a6 stores the new handle back into [rbx+r14*8+0x7f8]. A box of -1 reads mgr+0x8000007f0 and faults (0x1434c3656); 99 reads mgr+0xb10, inside the per-car records. Core sends a box >= 40 to site_Game_PitLane_BoxPoseFalse with edi = 2, so boxes 24..39 still reach the tuning handles. Needs L2 promotion by the game owner.

verify.notes: V8550 sigcheck OK unique match 0x1434c3653 target 0x1434c3653; disasm mov r14d,edi / mov r8,[rbx+r14*8+0x7f8]; edi=r9d box from prologue 0x1434c358d; r14d zero-extends so box -1 reads mgr+0x7f8+0x7fffffff8 and faults at 0x1434c3656
